title: Cosmic
tagline: Astrology based dating app with verified profiles, zodiac matches & horoscope compatibility.
description: This app blends modern dating with traditional astrology. Users start by verifying their identity through Self, ensuring authenticity and trust. Once verified, their birthdate is used to assign a zodiac sign. They can then add their exact birth time to generate a detailed horoscope. Before two people match, their horoscopes are compared for compatibility, bringing the concept of kundli matching into the dating experience. After successful matches, users can chat and build real connections. The swipe-style interface keeps the flow engaging and familiar, while the astrology-driven layer adds a unique and cultural dimension.
how_its_made:
Identity & Proofs: Self Protocol handles user verification and secure sharing of birth details.

Backend: Horoscope and kundli matching logic runs on a backend service connected to a  custom calculator.

Frontend: The dating interface is built with React/Next.js, styled with Tailwind, and supports swipe-based interactions.

Database: User data, matches, and chats are stored in a secure database (Supabase).

Chat & Matching: Real-time chat is enabled via WebSockets or Supabase channels once two users are matched.
